name: Shake and accelerometer delivery
prompt: Run the motion.shake-and-samples task on an Android emulator with the Motion Harness app foregrounded.

validation.prompt: Verify the app, not just the host, visibly reports both a detected shake and the custom acceleration sample.
assertions: The Motion Harness app reports Shake detected after the simulated shake.
The Motion Harness app reports Custom sample observed after the configured accelerometer sequence.
